verdict.rationale: Lighthouse offers EB-1A and EB-2 NIW petition services alongside O-1A, using the same criteria-mapping approach. Its Plus tier lists 'Immigrant Pathway Strategy Planning', and it publishes pathway-comparison content and an EB-1A guide. That gives a plausible continuation path, but nothing explicitly documents an O-1 → green-card strategy, and the pathway planning is framed for employer workforces on a higher tier. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of O-1-to-EB-1A/NIW sequencing, founder-facing continuation strategy content, evidence-reuse guidance between petitions, and independent corroboration.
